description.value: The Seine Boat Inn is a historic waterfront inn built on pilings directly over the beach and ocean in Alert Bay on Cormorant Island, a 40-minute BC Ferry ride from Port McNeill. Just a three-minute walk from the ferry terminal, the inn sits at the heart of a vibrant community steeped in 'Na̱mg̱is First Nation culture, with the U'mista Cultural Centre and coastal trails nearby. Its name honours the purse seiners, gill netters, and long liners that shaped this authentic fishing village.

address.value: 60 Fir Street, Alert Bay, BC V0N 1A0

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is fully accessible and corroborates all OSM contact details (phone, address, email). The amenities page and FAQ provide detailed room-level amenity lists, confirming free Wi-Fi with a named password, nearby grocery and evening dining options. No mention of bike storage, bike-specific facilities, laundry, or e-bike charging at the property appears anywhere on the site; the EV charging reference in the FAQ points to off-site stations in Alert Bay, not at the inn itself.
concerns: OSM community field shows 'Unknown / Vancouver Island & Gulf Islands'; Alert Bay is on Cormorant Island, accessible only by ferry or float plane — directory users should be aware of the ferry access requirement.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, active, publicly bookable waterfront accommodation in Alert Bay; website is current (© 2026) with full booking functionality.
enrichment_extras.notes: Limited guest parking is available across the street; the inn notes EV charging stations are located elsewhere in Alert Bay (off-site, not at the property). Pets allowed in select rooms with advance arrangement and a damage deposit.

Nearby evening food.detail: FAQ lists The Orca Restaurant & Pub (Wed–Sat evenings), Pemba's Kitchen at The Nimpkish (Wed–Mon from 11:30 AM), Alert Bay Pizza Delivery (7 days/week evenings), and Bayside Grill, all within the village
